aboutUs.main: We are an education-based team from Ukraine. This React project was made by people for people.

paragraphs.first: CineApp is a learning project created to make choosing a film or series easier, faster, and more enjoyable. The application brings together catalog pages, detailed screens, filters, and randomizers so viewers can move from browsing to watching without getting stuck in endless searching.
paragraphs.second: The project is built as a practical React application, so every page is also a small exercise in clean components, routing, state, API requests, styling, and user experience. We focus on making the interface simple enough for a first visit, but useful enough to return to when you need a quick recommendation.
paragraphs.third: Our goal is to keep improving the app step by step: better search, clearer pages, more helpful filters, stronger responsive design, and a friendlier path from curiosity to a good movie night.

cards.build_text: A comfortable movie discovery space with filters, random picks, and detailed pages.
cards.matters_text: Good recommendations save time and make the choice feel lighter.

apiDocs.subtitle: REST API reference for the Film service (TMDB)
apiDocs.description: API for working with films through TMDB. It supports filtering by genre and rating, plus loading full movie details.

endpoints.discover: Returns movies filtered by genre and/or minimum rating.
endpoints.details: Returns full details for a single movie, including runtime and named genres.

hooks.film_query: Fetches popular or filtered movies for a given page. Query key: ['popularFilms', page, filters].
hooks.film_by_id: Fetches full details for a single movie. Query key: ['film', id].

helpers.genres: Returns the static genre list mapped to translated names via i18n.

apiDocs.errors_intro: All errors are thrown from the Axios interceptor as

errors.401: Invalid or missing API key. Check VITE_TMDB_API_KEY in .env.
errors.404: Movie not found. The app renders the empty state in Film.tsx.
errors.429: Rate limit exceeded. TMDB free tier allows about 40 requests per 10 seconds.
errors.500: Server error. It is surfaced through the query error state.
